solve_pnp_pose: solve the perspective-n-point problem using 6p algorithm, ePnP, and LORANSAC with focal length search
generate_focal_factors: generate a list of focal length factors for PnP solver focal length search trials
run_pnp_with_ransac: run PnP pose estimation with RANSAC sampling and local refinement on 3D-2D point correspondences
estimate_camera_intrinsics: estimate camera pose and intrinsics by searching over multiple focal length candidates
refine_pnp_solution: refine PnP pose estimates using efficient PnP local refinement and LORANSAC inlier selection
